import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, bisect
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
from check import decode
import solver, randlayout, harness, native

harness.SMALL = False
rng = random.Random(94)
ncases = rng.randint(1, 2)
cases, allversions = [], []
for _ in range(ncases):
    c, vs = harness.gen_case(rng, 0)
    cases.append(c); allversions.append(vs)
request = {"cases": [harness.to_json_case(c) for c in cases]}
payload = json.dumps(request).encode()
env = dict(os.environ, FIDX_ENGINE='/workspace/tmp/engine')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', harness.ENTRY], input=payload,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
actual = decode(p.stdout)
for ci, (case, versions, res) in enumerate(zip(cases, allversions, actual["cases"])):
    print('case', ci, 'cache', case['cache_pages'], 'costs', case['costs'],
          'R', [len(v[0]) for v in versions])
    print('  objective', res['objective'])
    per_version = [[] for _ in versions]
    for v, rep, addrs in case["bursts"]:
        per_version[v].append((rep, addrs))
    # recompute objective of the submitted layout independently
    layouts = []
    for (starts, hops), ver in zip(versions, res["versions"]):
        nodes = []
        # decode the image with the auditor and rebuild the node list
        from audit import decode_image
        nd, size = decode_image(ver["image"], starts, hops)
        order = sorted(nd.keys())
        # reconstruct in BFS record order
        recs = []
        for off in order:
            n = nd[off]
            recs.append({"kind": n["kind"], "mode": n["mode"], "cached": n["cached"],
                         "lo": n["lo"], "span": n["span"],
                         "children": [order.index(c) for c in n["children"]],
                         "offset": off, "pages": n["pages"]})
        layouts.append((recs, size))
    work = pages = 0
    for (starts, hops), (recs, size), pv in zip(versions, layouts, per_version):
        touch, qpref = solver.traffic(len(starts), [(r, [bisect.bisect_right(starts, a) - 1 for a in addrs]) for r, addrs in pv])
        for n in recs:
            work += solver.node_cost(n, touch, qpref, tuple(case["costs"]))
        pages += size
    print('  independent recomputation of plan objective:', [work, pages])
    # random search for a better layout
    best = (res["objective"][0], res["objective"][1])
    found = None
    r2 = random.Random(1234)
    for trial in range(3000):
        tot = []
        ok = True
        for (starts, hops), pv in zip(versions, per_version):
            root = randlayout.gen_tree(r2, 0, len(starts), starts)
            nodes = randlayout.flatten(root)
            randlayout.mark_cache(r2, nodes, starts, hops, case["cache_pages"])
            image = randlayout.build_image(starts, hops, nodes)
            got = randlayout.evaluate(starts, hops, image, pv, tuple(case["costs"]), case["cache_pages"])
            if got is None:
                ok = False; break
            tot.append(got)
        if not ok: continue
        cand = (sum(g[0] for g in tot), sum(g[1] for g in tot))
        if cand < best:
            found = cand
            print('  BETTER', cand)
            best = cand
    print('  best random', best)
EOF
